annotations.text:
Tap the button: it goes idle - finding you - found, and the secondary link flips to the denied state.

Four states in one screen, matching what onboarding.jsx already tracks (locating / detectedZone / denied).

One deliberate change from your reference: the reference is green throughout. Green means money and nothing else in your system, so the CTA and the map glow are indigo #4338CA. Using green here would be the first place in the app where it means something other than rupees.
The city is drawn, not an asset - plain SVG polygons on an isometric grid, three faces per block. No image to ship, recolours with a token, and stays sharp at any density.
